recovery: Exact elastic return in its infinitesimal domain.
wave_propagation: Supports nondispersive longitudinal and shear waves with positive inertia.
progressive_hardening: None; tangent is constant.
weak_field_compatibility: Required Lamé-type tangent when moduli are positive.

recovery: Reversible on a stable branch.
wave_propagation: Conditional elastic waves where strong ellipticity holds.
progressive_hardening: Not reliably progressive; can soften under finite loading.
weak_field_compatibility: Matches Hooke elasticity.

recovery: Reversible to the unique energy minimum.
wave_propagation: Finite elastic waves if the tangent is strongly elliptic.
progressive_hardening: Usually mild; no finite-chain stiffening.
weak_field_compatibility: Positive Lamé tangent with suitable U.

recovery: Reversible on a stable parameter branch.
wave_propagation: Conditional on positive acoustic tensor and inertia.
progressive_hardening: Parameter-dependent; not necessarily monotone.
weak_field_compatibility: Can share the common positive tangent.

recovery: Reversible on stable branches.
wave_propagation: Conditional; acoustic tensor can lose positivity for some parameters.
progressive_hardening: Can harden or soften depending on exponents and coefficients.
weak_field_compatibility: Parameters can be constrained to the frozen tangent.

recovery: Reversible if energy remains single-well.
wave_propagation: Conditional on tangent positivity and kinetic closure.
progressive_hardening: Natural for nonnegative higher coefficients.
weak_field_compatibility: Quadratic tangent is selectable.

recovery: Reversible within the open elastic domain.
wave_propagation: Conditional before the barrier.
progressive_hardening: Strong asymptotic hardening.
weak_field_compatibility: Reduces to neo-Hooke at small strain.

recovery: Reversible below chain limit.
wave_propagation: Conditional elastic waves.
progressive_hardening: Progressive finite-chain hardening.
weak_field_compatibility: Neo-Hookean leading limit.

recovery: Reversible idealization.
wave_propagation: Conditional on strong ellipticity.
progressive_hardening: Strong smooth progressive hardening.
weak_field_compatibility: Expansion supplies a quadratic weak tangent.

recovery: Reversible on SPD domain.
wave_propagation: Conditional where ellipticity holds.
progressive_hardening: Constant in H; not progressive along log-strain rays.
weak_field_compatibility: Matches linear elasticity.

recovery: Reversible if the deviatoric law is elastic.
wave_propagation: Shear waves possible; compressional mode becomes constrained.
progressive_hardening: Inherited from What.
weak_field_compatibility: Eliminates volumetric compliance, which may conflict with the frozen tangent.

recovery: Conservative recovery; boundary conditions matter.
wave_propagation: Supports dispersive elastic waves with positive inertia.
progressive_hardening: Inherited from W; gradient stiffens short wavelengths, not amplitudes.
weak_field_compatibility: Local tangent remains common; q-dependent stiffness appears.

recovery: Conservative for symmetric kernels.
wave_propagation: Dispersive waves for a positive Fourier symbol and inertia.
progressive_hardening: Kernel nonlinearity may harden; linear kernels do not.
weak_field_compatibility: Kernel moments can recover local elasticity.

recovery: Elastic bonds recover; bond-breaking versions do not.
wave_propagation: Supports dispersive waves; stability follows positive bond stiffness.
progressive_hardening: Nonlinear bond force can harden or soften.
weak_field_compatibility: Local elasticity recovered asymptotically, with bond-based Poisson restrictions.

recovery: Elastic recovery when energy is positive.
wave_propagation: Additional rotational/optic wave branches.
progressive_hardening: Usually linear; nonlinear versions may harden.
weak_field_compatibility: Adds rotational modes beyond ordinary elasticity.

recovery: Conservative smooth solutions can recover; shocks require entropy/dissipation.
wave_propagation: Supports amplitude-dependent speeds, steepening and shocks.
progressive_hardening: Inherited from W; can be progressive.
weak_field_compatibility: Linearized acoustic tensor recovers weak waves.

recovery: Elastic if fibres do not slip or yield.
wave_propagation: Tension waves along taut paths; slack regions do not transmit them.
progressive_hardening: Geometric recruitment and fibre law can harden.
weak_field_compatibility: An isotropic random network may homogenize to an elastic tangent.

recovery: Entropic reversible recovery in ideal conditions.
wave_propagation: Elastic waves after network homogenization and inertia.
progressive_hardening: Strong finite-extensibility hardening.
weak_field_compatibility: Small extension has a finite tangent after prestress/reference choice.

recovery: Reversible idealization.
wave_propagation: Direction-dependent elastic waves.
progressive_hardening: Fibre recruitment gives strong hardening.
weak_field_compatibility: Can share an isotropic tangent if orientations average isotropically.

recovery: Elastic return while tension remains positive.
wave_propagation: Strong transverse membrane waves under positive tension.
progressive_hardening: Geometric stiffening can occur with deflection.
weak_field_compatibility: Small waves depend on prestress, not solely material modulus.

recovery: Elastic on a stable branch.
wave_propagation: Dispersive flexural waves plus membrane waves.
progressive_hardening: Geometric nonlinearities may harden or buckle/soften.
weak_field_compatibility: Flexural omega scales as q^2 without tension.

recovery: Returns density via pressure but not shear shape.
wave_propagation: Supports longitudinal sound; no elastic shear waves.
progressive_hardening: Equation of state may stiffen in compression.
weak_field_compatibility: Sound speed squared dp/drho must be positive.

recovery: Creep is bounded and unloading recovers asymptotically.
wave_propagation: Damped/dispersive elastic waves with inertia.
progressive_hardening: Linear version has no progressive hardening.
weak_field_compatibility: Recovers Hooke elasticity at low rate/static limit.

recovery: Does not recover total strain after unloading.
wave_propagation: Frequency-dependent waves may be overdamped at low frequency.
progressive_hardening: Linear model has no progressive hardening.
weak_field_compatibility: Has elastic response at high frequency.

recovery: Recovers to zero strain for zero stress.
wave_propagation: Damped waves with bounded low/high frequency moduli.
progressive_hardening: Linear unless nonlinear springs are used.
weak_field_compatibility: Positive relaxed modulus supplies weak recovery.

recovery: Conformation relaxes, but material elements flow.
wave_propagation: Complex elastic/viscous modes; often diffusive or damped.
progressive_hardening: Hookean chains do not finitely harden.
weak_field_compatibility: Positive zero-shear viscosity, elastic high-rate response.

recovery: No generic recovery of shear deformation.
wave_propagation: First and second sound plus vortical excitations.
progressive_hardening: Equation of state, not progressive elastic hardening.
weak_field_compatibility: Sound modes exist with positive thermodynamic derivatives.

recovery: Hamiltonian but not recovery of an elastic C state.
wave_propagation: Bogoliubov sound and dispersive short waves.
progressive_hardening: Nonlinear density pressure; not finite-strain hardening.
weak_field_compatibility: Linearization gives acoustic dispersion.

recovery: Exact in the harmonic idealization.
wave_propagation: Acoustic and optical dispersive branches.
progressive_hardening: None; harmonic tangent is constant.
weak_field_compatibility: Continuum long-wave limit is Hookean.

recovery: Conservative; recovery depends on phase/mode distribution.
wave_propagation: Nonlinear dispersion, mode coupling, solitons and recurrences.
progressive_hardening: Positive quartic terms harden at large amplitude.
weak_field_compatibility: Harmonic long-wave limit.

recovery: Conservative return locally.
wave_propagation: Phonon-like waves about a stable minimum.
progressive_hardening: Depends on anharmonic curvature of V.
weak_field_compatibility: Hessian at equilibrium gives elastic constants.

recovery: Recoverable only before buckling damage/plasticity.
wave_propagation: Elastic waves with band/dispersion effects.
progressive_hardening: Densification produces strong compressive hardening after a plateau.
weak_field_compatibility: Low effective moduli controlled by relative density.

recovery: Reversible ideal network.
wave_propagation: Elastic waves after homogenization.
progressive_hardening: Finite chains or nonaffinity can harden.
weak_field_compatibility: Isotropic orientation average yields standard elastic tangent.

recovery: Does not recover plastic deformation.
wave_propagation: Elastic precursor waves; plastic waves/shocks possible.
progressive_hardening: Yes, through evolving yield strength, not reversible tangent hardening.
weak_field_compatibility: Elastic tangent before yield.

recovery: Irreversibility constraint d_dot>=0 prevents recovery.
wave_propagation: Waves attenuate/scatter as damage grows.
progressive_hardening: Softening, not progressive elastic hardening.
weak_field_compatibility: Undamaged tangent can match elasticity.

recovery: Recovery requires thermal or stress cycling; hysteretic.
wave_propagation: Complex dispersive/attenuated waves across phases.
progressive_hardening: Plateaus and subsequent hardening, not monotone single-well response.
weak_field_compatibility: One well has an elastic tangent.

recovery: Frictionless elastic contacts may recover; rearrangements/hysteresis generally do not.
wave_propagation: Acoustic modes emerge above jamming; anomalous soft modes near threshold.
progressive_hardening: Hertz contacts harden with overlap; network changes can soften.
weak_field_compatibility: Moduli vanish or scale near the jamming point.

recovery: Potentially reversible without hysteresis.
wave_propagation: Coupled magnetoacoustic waves.
progressive_hardening: Field can stiffen or soften depending on coupling.
weak_field_compatibility: At zero field can reduce to ordinary elasticity.

recovery: May recover but can have domains/hysteresis.
wave_propagation: Coupled acoustic and orientational modes.
progressive_hardening: Often soft or semisoft rather than progressively hardening.
weak_field_compatibility: Director relaxation changes the apparent tangent.

recovery: Often metastable and hysteretic.
wave_propagation: Unusual dispersion; stability requires positive total dynamic energy.
progressive_hardening: Can switch, soften or show negative incremental stiffness.
weak_field_compatibility: Weak effective modulus can be enhanced or approach instability.

recovery: Elastic idealization recovers; damping can be added.
wave_propagation: Strongly dispersive waves and stop bands.
progressive_hardening: Not amplitude hardening unless resonators are nonlinear.
weak_field_compatibility: Long-wave effective parameters are frequency dependent.

recovery: Reversible on a stable branch.
wave_propagation: Dispersive nonlinear elastic waves with positive inertia.
progressive_hardening: Inherited from Phi; can be polynomial, exponential or barrier.
weak_field_compatibility: Common PBUF tangent plus q-dependent correction.

recovery: Reversible idealization.
wave_propagation: Anisotropic waves.
progressive_hardening: Recruitment/finite fibres progressively harden.
weak_field_compatibility: Isotropic tangent possible only for isotropic orientation ensemble.

recovery: Equilibrium branch recovers; transient branches relax.
wave_propagation: Damped nonlinear elastic waves.
progressive_hardening: Can inherit progressive hardening from W_eq.
weak_field_compatibility: Equilibrium tangent can match PBUF.
